svg.text: How a raster finds its mask: by MD5
DSC02091 record 0 (a Sky mask), followed from the XMP into the .acr and back onto the canvas
Every one of the 300 records in 76 files matched an XMP reference, and every reference matched a record.
Table order differs from XMP order in 74 of 76 files, so position means nothing; the MD5 is the link.
The local cache stores the same record as auxiliary\<md5>, byte for byte.
